## Objective
Identify small intestinal fragments based on villi and crypts

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)

subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning.json")

image_names <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning$image_name


fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/"
layers_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/process_combos/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_fragments/output/si_fragments/"

layer_files <- list.files(layers_dir)
#filter for files with layers file
matching_image_names <- image_names[ sapply(image_names, function(name) {
  any(startsWith(layer_files, name))
}) ]

si_fragment_template <- NULL
for (image in matching_image_names){
  fragment_path <- paste0(fragment_dir, image, "_fragments.geojson")
  fragments <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_set_crs(0) %>%
    select(id:name, geometry)
  
  fragment_names <- fragments$name
  
  included_fragments <- fragments %>% filter(classification == "included_fragment")
  
  fragment_names <- included_fragments$name
  
  duplicate_fragments <- fragments %>% filter(classification == "duplicate_fragment") %>%
    mutate(classification = "duplicate")
  
  si_fragments <- duplicate_fragments
  
  for (frag in fragment_names){
    fragment <- fragments %>% filter(name == frag)
    
    layer_path <- paste0(layers_dir,image, "_", frag, "_layers.geojson")
    
  
    layers <- st_read(layer_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0)
    
    if (nrow(layers) == 0) {
      layer_flags <- fragment %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        mutate(si = "no_si") %>%
        select(name, si)
      } else {
        
        layer_flags <- layers %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          select(-name) %>%
          rename(name = fragment_name) %>%
          group_by(name) %>%
          summarise(
            has_crypts = any(classification == "crypts"),
            has_villi = any(classification == "villi"),
            .groups = "drop"
            ) %>%
          
          mutate(
            si = case_when(
              has_crypts & has_villi ~ "si",
              has_crypts & !has_villi ~ "crypts_only",
              !has_crypts & has_villi ~ "villi_only",
              TRUE ~ "no_si"))
        }
    si_fragment <- fragment %>%
      left_join(layer_flags %>% select(name, si), by = "name") %>%
      mutate(si = replace_na(si, "no_si")) %>%
      mutate(classification = case_when(
                                        classification == "included_fragment" & si == "crypts_only" ~ "crypts_only",
                                        classification == "included_fragment" & si == "villi_only" ~ "villi_only",
                                        classification == "included_fragment" & si == "no_si" ~ "no_si",
                                        classification == "duplicated_fragment" ~ "duplicate",
                                        TRUE ~ classification)) %>%
    select(id:name, geometry)
    
    si_fragments <- bind_rows(si_fragments, si_fragment)
  
  }
  
  st_write(si_fragments, paste0(output_dir, image, "_si_fragments.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  template <- si_fragments %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, classification)
  
  si_fragment_template <- bind_rows(si_fragment_template, template)

}

write_xlsx(si_fragment_template, paste0(output_dir, "si_fragments_template.xlsx"))
```
